items.en: I have many books.
I have little money.
There are many children here.
There are few children here.
This house is very big.
This book is very cheap.
I have a lot of time.
My father has work.
My work is good.

items.pashto: زما مور ښوونکې ده، دا ښه کار دی.
items.en: My mother is a teacher, this is good work.
Do you have work?

items.pashto: زما ملګری ډاکټر دی، دا ښه کار دی.
items.en: My friend is a doctor, this is good work.
I want work.
What is your job?
This book is new.
This house is old.
My car is new.
This tree is old.
I want new clothes.

items.pashto: دا موټر نوی دی که زوړ؟
items.en: Is this car new or old?
My books are new.
This is my book.
This is my car.
These are my clothes.

items.pashto: زما کور کې یو کتاب دی.
items.en: There is a book in my house.

items.pashto: زما کوټه کې یوه مڼه ده.
items.en: There is an apple in my room.

items.pashto: دا کتاب ارزان دی، دا موټر ګران دی.
items.en: This book is cheap, this car is expensive.
I have many books.
Today is Friday.

items.pashto: زه د جمعې په ورځ کور کې یم.
items.en: On Friday I am at home.
Tomorrow is Saturday.
Tomorrow I go to the market.
My family is at home.
We eat food today.
How is your Friday?
Hello, my name is Ali.
What is your name?
My name is Fatima.
This is my friend Ahmad.
Thank you, have a good day!
My friend is Fatima.
This is my name.

items.pashto: زموږ کور دری خونې لري، زما کورنۍ لویه ده.
items.en: Our house has three rooms, my family is big.

items.pashto: زما پلار او مور ښه دي.
items.en: My father and mother are good.

items.pashto: زما یو ورور دی، زما یوه خور ده.
items.en: I have one brother, I have one sister.

items.pashto: زما زوی ښه دی. زما لور ښه ده.
items.en: My son is good. My daughter is good.

items.pashto: زما نیکه او انا زموږ کور کې دي.
items.en: My grandfather and grandmother are in our house.

items.pashto: زما کوټه کوچنۍ ده، زما کوټه ښه ده.
items.en: My room is small, my room is good.

items.pashto: ستا مور او پلار چېرته دي؟
items.en: Where are your mother and father?

items.pashto: نن هوا ګرمه ده، دوبی دی.
items.en: Today the weather is hot, it is summer.

items.pashto: غر لوی دی، سيند نږدې دی.
items.en: The mountain is big, the river is near.
It is raining, the weather is cold.
The sky is blue, the sun is out.

items.pashto: ونه زموږ کور ته نږدې ده.
items.en: The tree is near our house.

items.pashto: ژمی سوړ دی، پسرلی ښه دی.
items.en: Winter is cold, spring is good.
How is the weather today?

items.pashto: زه لس کتابونه لرم، زما لس دقیقې دي.
items.en: I have ten books, I have ten minutes.
It is one hour now.
There are twenty children here.
I go to the market tomorrow.

items.pashto: نن جمعه ده، سبا شنبه ده.
items.en: Today is Friday, tomorrow is Saturday.
A week has seven days.
What time is it now?

items.pashto: ته چېرته ځې؟ زه ښوونځي ته ځم.
items.en: Where do you go? I go to school.

items.pashto: دا څه دی؟ دا کتاب دی.
items.en: What is this? This is a book.

items.pashto: ته څوک یې؟ زه ستا ملګری یم.
items.en: Who are you? I am your friend.

items.pashto: زه هره ورځ کتاب لولم او ډوډۍ خورم.
items.en: I read a book and eat food every day.
When do you go home?

items.pashto: زه اوبه غواړم، ته څه غواړې؟
items.en: I want water, what do you want?

items.pashto: موږ ښوونځي ته ځو، تاسو چېرته ځئ؟
items.en: We go to school, where do you go?

items.pashto: زه بازار ته ځم، زما پیسې دي.
items.en: I go to the market, I have money.

items.pashto: دا کتاب ارزان دی، دا موټر ګران دی.
items.en: This book is cheap, this car is expensive.

items.pashto: زه مڼه غواړم، مڼه ارزانه ده.
items.en: I want an apple, the apple is cheap.

items.pashto: ته پیسې لرې؟ هو، زه پیسې لرم.
items.en: Do you have money? Yes, I have money.

items.pashto: بازار زموږ کور ته نږدې دی.
items.en: The market is near our house.

items.pashto: زه نوي کالي غواړم، دا ارزان دي.
items.en: I want new clothes, these are cheap.
Is this cheap or expensive?

items.pashto: سلام، زما نوم دی. ستا نوم څه دی؟
items.en: Hello, my name is... What is your name?
I am well, thank you.

items.pashto: زما کورنۍ لویه ده، موږ ښار کې یو.
items.en: My family is big, we are in the city.

items.pashto: زه هره ورځ ښوونځي ته ځم، کتاب لولم.
items.en: I go to school every day, I read a book.

items.pashto: نن هوا ښه ده، زه بازار ته ځم.
items.en: Today the weather is good, I go to the market.

items.pashto: زما کورنۍ ښه ده. زما ملګری ښه دی.
items.en: My family is good. My friend is good.
Have a good day! Thank you!
